A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<table><tr><td><img src="a.svg" alt="A"> <a href="/1">x</a></td><td><a href="/2">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href="/3">z</a></td></tr></table>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
